SSS.SUBTITLE: Frequently Asked Questions
SSS.Q1: How long does Mercedes restoration take?
SSS.A1: The process varies between 3-6 months depending on the vehicle condition.
SSS.Q2: Is there an original parts guarantee?
SSS.A2: 100% original Mercedes parts are our priority in all our projects.
SSS.Q3: Is VIP design registered on the license?
SSS.A3: Yes, all our transformations are done in accordance with the license with TSE approved projects.
SSS.A4: We recreate old model buses with the latest technology from scratch.
SSS.A5: We only accept vehicles with appointments to maintain our quality of workmanship.
SSS.Q6: Do you accept vehicles from outside the city?
SSS.A6: Logistic support is available for our projects across Turkey and abroad.
SSS.A7: All electronic components in our VIP designs are under a 2-year guarantee.
SSS.A8: Prices are determined according to the selected material quality and equipment.

VIP_DESIGN.LUXURY_DESC: Equipped with top-segment materials, a fully customizable luxury living space. It offers office comfort on business trips and palace comfort on family travels.
VIP_DESIGN.ECONOMY_DESC: Designed for those seeking more compact and functional solutions without compromising on quality. Provides long-lasting use with ergonomic seat structure and durable materials.
VIP_DESIGN.COMMERCIAL_SUBTITLE: The New Office of the Business World
VIP_DESIGN.COMMERCIAL_DESC: We transform your commercial vehicles into a mobile office. Everything from meeting tables to high-speed internet infrastructure is ready for your professional needs.

BUS_DESIGN.MULTIMEDIA_DESC: We are revolutionizing in-bus entertainment systems. We make comfort the standard with private multimedia screens for each seat, high-quality sound systems, and independent USB charging units for every passenger.
BUS_DESIGN.UPHOLSTERY_DESC: Custom design seat upholstery that makes you forget the fatigue of long journeys. We recreate the interior with non-sweating fabric technology, genuine leather options, and modern patterns suitable for every bus type.
BUS_DESIGN.STORAGE_DESC: Luggage racks and storage systems that use the bus interior volume most efficiently. We make luggage areas safer and more useful with durable materials and stylish lighting details.
